title: Finite-cover profinite action-space presentation of the condensed action topos
statement:
Work in compatible universes and small skeletons [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $J$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group. Let $P$ be the site of profinite sets with finite jointly surjective covering families [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Define $P_J$ to have profinite spaces $T$ with a continuous left $J$-action, continuous equivariant maps, and finite families whose underlying maps are jointly surjective as coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Write $h_T(S)=C(S,T)$, with its induced internal $\underline J$-action. Then $P_J$ is a small subcanonical site with finite limits, calculated on the underlying profinite spaces with their induced actions; the finite covering families are stable under pullback and finite indexed composition. Its representable sheaves are coherent objects and generate its sheaf topos [def-trf-coherent-topos].

Put $\mathscr E=\operatorname{Sh}(P)$, and let $\mathscr E^{\underline J}$ denote the topos of internal $\underline J$-actions [lem-sfb-action-topos-geometric-restriction]. The assignment
$$\Phi(X)(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathscr E^{\underline J}}(h_T,X)$$
is an equivalence $\mathscr E^{\underline J}\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(P_J)$. For a commutative condensed ring $R$, give $R$ the trivial action, set $\mathcal R_J=\Phi(R)$, and give $\Phi(N)(T)$ its module structure by pointwise scalar multiplication. This induces an exact additive equivalence from internal $R$-modules with $\underline J$-action [def-sfb-condensed-action-module, sk-def-sfb-module-objects] to sheaves of $\mathcal R_J$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

Let $t:P\to P_J$ equip a profinite set with trivial action, and let $p_J:\mathscr E^{\underline J}\to\mathscr E$ be the geometric morphism whose inverse image is trivial inflation [lem-sfb-action-topos-geometric-restriction]. The functor $t$ preserves finite limits and coverings and presents this geometric morphism: under $\Phi$, its direct image is $F\mapsto(S\mapsto F(tS))$. There are canonical identifications $\mathcal R_J(tS)=R(S)$ and
$$\Phi(N)(tS)=\Gamma_{R,J}(N)(S),\qquad \Phi(N)(J\times S)=N(S),$$
where $J\times S$ has left translation on its first factor and $\Gamma_{R,J}(N)(S)$ consists of those sections fixed after every profinite base change [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. All identifications are natural in equivariant module maps and in continuous maps of profinite parameters; on morphisms the first identification restricts the original map to fixed sections and the second is its original component on $S$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-profinite-action-finite-cover-site] to obtain smallness, underlying-space finite limits, stable finite covers, subcanonicity and the finite-limit/cover preservation of $t$. The hypotheses are precisely that $J$ is compact Hausdorff totally disconnected. Apply [lem-trf-finitary-site-coherent-generators] to this finite-limit finite-cover site; subcanonicity identifies its sheafified representables with representables, giving coherence and generation.

source.place: Paragraph (3), assembly of the extracted profinite-action auxiliary lemmas; returned proof steps 1--4

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-profinite-action-yoneda-free-evaluation], the stated restricted Yoneda formula defines the sheaf functor $\Phi$. By [lem-sfb-profinite-action-free-restriction], free restriction $G(F)(S)=F(J\times S)$ with $g\cdot x=F(r_g)x$ defines an internal action. Apply [lem-sfb-profinite-action-cech-recovery]: the action-cover equalizers give $F\simeq\Phi G(F)$ and identity evaluation gives $G\Phi(X)\simeq X$, naturally and equivariantly. These natural quasi-inverse isomorphisms prove the required equivalence.

source.place: Paragraph (3), assembly of the extracted profinite-action auxiliary lemmas; returned proof steps 5--10

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-profinite-action-module-lift] to the commutative condensed ring $R$ with trivial action. Its additive functors and linear recovery isomorphisms give the asserted module equivalence, with ring $\mathcal R_J=\Phi(R)$ and pointwise scalars. By [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its target is abelian; the required smallness was proved in step 1. Transport this abelian structure across the additive equivalence. A kernel or cokernel factorization transports through a quasi-inverse and back, and faithfulness gives uniqueness. Hence the equivalence preserves kernels and cokernels, and is exact.

source.place: Paragraph (3), assembly of the extracted profinite-action auxiliary lemmas; returned proof steps 11--13

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-profinite-action-trivial-parameter-fixed]: $p_{J,*}X(S)=\Phi(X)(tS)$, while the inverse image of $p_J$ is trivial inflation. Thus restriction along $t$ presents this geometric morphism under $\Phi$. The same node identifies $\mathcal R_J(tS)$ with $R(S)$, trivial evaluation with the normalized fully fixed sections, and free evaluation with $N(S)$, as modules. Its naturality clauses give exactly restriction of $v_S$ on fixed sections, the original $v_S$ on free sections, and compatibility with every continuous parameter map.
